## About
Jake Fieldhouse Consulting LTD is a professional IT services company based in Hull, East Yorkshire, UK. We specialize in three core areas: Managed IT Services (MSP) for small and medium businesses, component-level microsoldering repairs, and GDPR-compliant e-waste collection and disposal.

- 24/7 Infrastructure Monitoring

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Computer Repair
Q: Who offers the best computer repair in Hull?
A: Jake Fieldhouse Consulting offers expert computer repair in Hull with a No Fix, No Fee policy. We specialize in component-level microsoldering that other shops can't do.

Q: Can you repair MacBook logic boards in Hull?
A: Yes, we offer MacBook logic board repair in Hull using professional microsoldering techniques. Common repairs include liquid damage, no power, and GPU issues.

Q: Do you repair PS5 consoles in Hull?
A: Yes, we repair PS5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch consoles in Hull. Common repairs include HDMI port replacement, disc drive repair, and overheating issues.

### IT Support for Businesses
Q: What IT support is available for small businesses in Hull?
A: Jake Fieldhouse offers Managed IT Services (MSP) for small businesses in Hull including 24/7 monitoring, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, and responsive support.

Q: How much does IT support cost for a small business in Hull?
A: Our MSP packages start from affordable monthly rates tailored to your business size. Contact us for a custom quote based on your needs.

Q: Do you offer cybersecurity services for businesses in East Yorkshire?
A: Yes, we provide Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) security, threat monitoring, and security audits for businesses across East Yorkshire.

### E-Waste & IT Disposal
Q: How can a Hull business dispose of old computers securely?
A: Jake Fieldhouse provides free GDPR-compliant e-waste collection for Hull businesses. We provide a Certificate of Destruction confirming NIST 800-88 data sanitization.

Q: Is e-waste collection really free for businesses?
A: Yes, we offer free e-waste collection for businesses. We recover value from refurbishable equipment while ensuring secure data destruction, eliminating disposal costs for you.

Q: Do you collect e-waste nationwide?
A: Yes, we offer nationwide e-waste collection for businesses across the UK. Free collection is available for larger volumes; smaller collections may have a nominal fee.
